request.description: Requires ib.plans.manage on the admin_panel surface. Returns non-archived plans ordered by code as data[].
Creates an inactive plan. progression_period is required (daily|weekly|monthly). module_ids is optional and must reference operational modules. Omitting requires_approval defaults to true.
Returns a non-archived plan with configured modules, requires_approval, progression_period and lock_version.

Partial update. module_ids replaces the complete binding set when present. Active plans cannot keep an empty set. Omitting requires_approval or progression_period preserves the persisted value. A progression_period change takes effect from the next window (BR-PLAN-019).
Activates a plan that has at least one operational module. Requires reason and lock_version.
Deactivates a plan. Requires reason and lock_version. Idempotent when already inactive.
Logically archives an inactive plan. Bindings are preserved and the code remains reserved. Not restored in P1.

request.description: Requires ib.programs.manage on the admin_panel surface. Returns programs of the plan ordered by position, including live entry_threshold.
Creates a program under a non-archived plan. entry_threshold is required. module_ids is optional and must be a subset of the plan bindings.
Returns a program with selected module_ids, entry_threshold and lock_version.
Partial update. module_ids replaces the complete selection set when present. Empty selections are allowed. entry_threshold is live and must keep the plan ladder strictly increasing.
Atomically reorders all programs of the plan and sets their live entry thresholds. programs must list every program exactly once with lock_version.
Atomically replaces the current program symbol set. Broker is consulted before the transaction; group and currency are derived from its live catalogue. Requires ib.programs.manage.

Requires ib.programs.manage on admin_panel. data is the configuration or [] when absent/retired. PUT fully replaces cadence/groups; groups=[] retires. Effective time and actor are set by IB. Requires explicitly assigned published negative_pnl_share version; opaque group validated remotely later.

Requires ib.programs.manage on admin_panel. data is the configuration or [] when absent/retired. PUT fully replaces cadence/groups; groups=[] retires. Effective time and actor are set by IB. Requires explicitly assigned published negative_pnl_share version; opaque group validated remotely later.
Requires ib.programs.manage. Replaces the historical mode with periodic, event or both; omitting mode defaults to periodic. data is the configuration object.

request.description: Requires ib.rules.manage on the admin_panel surface. Returns rules of the plan ordered by name.
Creates a rule under a non-archived plan. slug is generated from name and cannot be sent. Duplicate name or slug returns 409.
Returns a rule with its versions. Publishing does not mark any version as current.
Partial update of name or description. slug and strategy_type are prohibited. Renaming does not regenerate slug.
Returns versions of the rule ordered by version_number.
Creates a draft version. configuration must be valid for the rule strategy_type.
Returns a single rule version.
Updates a draft version. Published versions return RULE_VERSION_IMMUTABLE.
Publishes a draft version. Publishing does not activate it or replace other published versions.
Requires ib.rules.manage. Returns paginated assignment history for the rule. Filters: program_id, module_id, active.
Creates an active assignment. rule_version_id must be published. Module must be selected on the program. scope_type and dates are server-owned.
Returns a single assignment, including historical ones.
Closes the active assignment and creates a new active one with the published rule_version_id.
Closes an active assignment. Historical rows keep their rule_version_id unchanged.

request.description: Requires ib.subscriptions.manage. Returns subscriptions of every status as data[] with pagination and applied filters in meta.
Returns a subscription with its immutable change history and current placement when active.
Approves a pending subscription on the same requested plan. Omitting program_id uses the first program by position. Failures leave the pending request intact.
Rejects a pending subscription. reason is required and non-empty after trim.
Cancels an active subscription. Ends the subscription, closes the open placement and records cancel history. lock_version is required.

Ends the active subscription and creates a replacement active subscription on the destination plan. Omitting program_id uses the first program. Does not apply approval or transfer fixation. lock_version is required.
Changes the program of an active subscription within the same plan while preserving fixed/unfixed placement condition. lock_version is required.
Fixes placement on the current or another program of the same plan. Closes and opens contiguous intervals. lock_version is required.
Releases a fixed placement without changing the program. lock_version is required.
